protocol.scope: Select the smallest affected area and direct dependencies; exclude generated application outputs, dependency directories, caches, and unrelated source. Canonical `devspec/` artifacts remain in scope when the command owns them.
protocol.initialize: When a target artifact, required state record, or its parent folder is missing, create it from the matching _template artifact before editing. Resolve foundation artifacts through devspec/foundation/template-map.md. For a new work item, initialize every file from devspec/work-items/_template, including meta.md and decisions.md. For a new quickfix, initialize devspec/quickfixes/QF-###-slug.md from devspec/quickfixes/_template.md. Never overwrite an existing artifact.
protocol.evidence: Label durable facts as confirmed, observed, inferred, or blocked.
protocol.change: Prefer existing patterns and the smallest safe change; do not add speculative abstractions or dependencies.
protocol.artifacts: Update targeted sections only, link instead of duplicate, and preserve user-authored useful content.
